newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 7.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 7.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Finance Ministry said that according to the government's plans hospitals will receive two billion forints towards repaying debts.
- The Welfare Ministry is having a meeting behind closed doors about hospital consolidation.
- Welfare minister Gyorgy Szabo, who has offered his resignation on Wednesday, is attending today's cabinet meeting.
- The governing parties propose a 23 percent increase of family subsidies as of June 1997.
- Young Hungarians spend an estimated annual one billion forint on drugs.
